templates.name: Fire Drill Steps
templates.description: Five numbered steps for the evacuation procedure.

elements.text: Leave work where it is, do not collect bags or coats
Follow the green signs, no running and no talking
Line up on the tennis courts
Find your tutor group marker and stand in silence
Tutors take the register and report to the fire marshal
Only the senior leader on duty sends you back inside

elements.text: Queue outside in silence with your candidate number ready
Leave everything on the racks by the corridor door
Black pen, pencil, ruler and an approved calculator
Do not leave your seat once the paper has started
Invigilators collect every script before anyone stands
